title: Acquirer: Colgate Palmolive Pty Ltd; Target: Campbell Brothers

body_sections.Summary: Colgate Palmolive proposed to acquire brands and assets from Campbell Brothers relating to laundry, detergent, dishwashing and cleaner products.
body_sections.Market definition: For competition assessment purposes, the acquisition was considered in terms of the national markets for the manufacturing and supply of laundry detergent; fabric conditioner; dishwashing detergent; and household cleaners.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission decided not to oppose the acquisition and in reaching its decision took account of:  actual and potential capacity for supply side substitution;  recent and potential entry into the relevant markets through acquisitions and brand initiatives; countervailing power of the supermarket chains as buyers, supporters of new entrants and suppliers of house brands;  buying patterns of consumers in terms of discretionary purchasing, brand switching and price sensitivity; and the continued presence of Campbell Brothers in the markets as a manufacturer of third party brands.
